description: OCR Pipeline infrastructure - BullMQ job queue setup, OCR worker stub, job status tracking, and the tRPC router for OCR operations. Implements the queue-based architecture for document processing with mock OCR results. The actual Tesseract integration will be ready when the system connects to real infrastructure.
steps: Create src/lib/ocr/pipeline-config.ts: OCR pipeline configuration as defined in Product Spec Section 14. Export config object with: tile_size (4096), overlap_percent (15), dpi_target (400), min_dimension_for_tiling (5000), max_pixels, max_file_size_mb (500), max_pages (100), worker_concurrency (4), ocr_timeout_seconds (300), retry_count (3), confidence_threshold (60), dedup_threshold (0.6). Also export type definitions for OCR structured output

Create src/lib/ocr/ocr-service.ts: OCR service that manages the processing pipeline. Functions: queueDocument(docId) - creates OCR job record in mock-db, simulates processing stages. processDocument(jobId) - mock implementation that generates realistic structured extraction results (drawing_number, title, revision, pl_numbers array, confidence score). extractStructuredData(ocrText) - parse OCR text to find PL numbers (8-digit patterns), drawing numbers, revision codes

Create src/lib/ocr/structured-extraction.ts: Logic to extract structured data from OCR text. Regex patterns for: PL numbers (/\b\d{8}\b/), drawing numbers (/[A-Z]{2,4}\/[A-Z]+\/[A-Z]+\/\d{4}/), revision codes (/R\d+|Rev\.?\s*\d+/i), dates, title block fields. Returns typed OcrStructuredOutput

Create src/lib/ocr/tile-processor.ts: Tile calculation logic (no actual image processing in mock). Functions: calculateTiles(width, height, tileSize, overlap) - returns array of tile coordinates. mergeTileResults(tiles[]) - combines OCR text from overlapping tiles with deduplication. Exported for future Tesseract integration

Create src/server/routers/ocr.ts: OCR tRPC router: getQueue (list jobs by status), getJob (single job detail with progress), queueDocument (create new OCR job), retryJob, cancelJob, getStats (processing rate, avg confidence, failure rate). Uses mock-db service

Create src/lib/mock-data/ocr-jobs.ts: Mock OCR job data - 20+ jobs in various states (QUEUED, PROCESSING with partial progress, COMPLETED with results, FAILED with errors). Completed jobs include realistic structured extraction output

Create src/server/services/ocr-worker.ts: Mock OCR worker service. Simulates: job pickup, status progression (QUEUED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED/FAILED), progress updates (pages processed, tiles processed), confidence calculation, structured data extraction. Uses setTimeout to simulate async processing in dev mode

Create src/components/documents/ocr-results-panel.tsx: Component showing OCR extraction results on document detail page. Displays: confidence score (progress bar with color), extracted fields in organized grid (drawing#, title, revision, PL numbers found, sheet info, scale, date, approved_by), raw text toggle, warnings list. Each extracted PL number is a clickable link to PL registry
Update the documents detail page to include OCR results panel when ocr_status is COMPLETED
Update src/server/routers/_app.ts to include ocr router
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes
acceptance_criteria: OCR pipeline config matches Product Spec Section 14 parameters
Structured extraction regex correctly identifies PL numbers (8 digits), drawing numbers, revision codes
OCR service can queue documents and generate mock extraction results
tRPC ocr router provides queue status, job details, retry/cancel actions
Tile calculation logic correctly splits dimensions into overlapping tiles
Document detail page shows OCR results with confidence and extracted fields
Mock worker simulates job progression through status states
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
findings: All OCR pipeline files created and passing build. Lint has pre-existing formatting errors in graphify.json, schema files (users.ts, pl-numbers.ts, cases.ts, ocr-jobs.ts, index.ts) from prior features - not introduced by this feature. Our new files all pass biome check cleanly. The graphify update-graphify.ts script maps FEAT-014 to 'Settings and configuration pages' in graphify.json (different naming scheme) but ran successfully.
